candidates.excerpt:
I fell into the rabbit hole of TTS models lately. Tried all major paid tools (ElevenLabs/InWorld/etc.), and all the newest open-source models.

I started asking myself: what happens when the voice is "solved"? E.g. it gets impossible to distinguish it from a human. Wanted to hear your opinions!

candidates.discovered_via: github_query:is:issue is:open (bounty OR reward OR paid OR stipend) archived:false
candidates.excerpt: Every launch of a managed-npm ACP agent — capability probe, one-shot inference, and session start alike — runs `npx --yes --prefer-offline <package>` (`apps/backend/internal/agent/agents/managed_npm_runtime.go`, `CachedACPCommand`).
